name: agent-inbox
description: One inbox for every Claude Code session that is waiting on you (permission, question, turn finished), grouped by project, with one-click jump to the session.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language of the inbox pane. 'auto' follows LANG / the macOS system language.

autoOpen.title: Open pane automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the inbox pane when a Claude Desktop session starts (terminal sessions use /inbox).

inboxPath.title: Inbox file
inboxPath.description: The JSONL file the hook writes waiting sessions to.
